subject: Literature
title: Kafka and the Absurd
description: A short lesson to help you apply Kafka and the Absurd.

hook.text: Franz Kafka wrote a story where a man wakes up as a giant insect, and the family's main concern is the rent.

buildup.text: The Metamorphosis and The Trial depicted worlds where logic fails and bureaucracy crushes the individual.

discovery.text: The word 'Kafkaesque' entered dictionaries worldwide to describe absurd, nightmarish bureaucratic situations.

twist.text: Kafka asked his friend Max Brod to burn all his manuscripts after death. Brod published them instead.

climax.text: Kafka's work predicted the absurdity of totalitarian bureaucracies decades before they fully emerged.

punchline.text: A dead man's disobeyed wish gave the world Kafka.

quiz.question: What happened to Kafka's manuscripts after his death?
options: They were locked in a museum vault
His friend published them instead of burning them as requested
They were translated into German for the first time
